rationale: Adds five new persisted tables (contacts, thread_entries, contact_tone_history, commitments, nudges), a new aggregation view, and new column on existing emails table; modifies email-normaliser workflow to add a third branch to already-verified ingestion path (must stay non-blocking); widens Gmail ingestion scope to include sent mail.

signals.blast_radius: Gmail ingestion scope (SENT label), n8n workflows (email-normaliser branch + new commitment-extraction), database (7 new entities), data mappers (2 new, 1 modified), API (7 new routes), frontend (2 new providers, 2 rewired pages), architecture docs
signals.unresolved: Four questions carried forward: sent-mail history scope (all or start date), nudge send vs. persist (defaulted to persist here; sending is separate change), backfill necessity (marked out of scope), getAwaitingReply semantics (needs pinning to current fixture behavior)
signals.irreversibility: Migrations additive and git-revertible, routes additive, but VIP toggle persistence means reverting loses user-set state; Gmail scope widening means future ingestion would not include sent mail if reverted
